correctness.rationale: Equation (1) accounts for artificial zero-part quotient modes; Sherman–Morrison gives (2) with 1-S>0. The fixed-pair objective equals the linear-fractional formula (3) with strictly positive denominator. Differentiation yields (4); the uniform bound S_0<=(r-2)/r gives U-cT>=2n>0, so the inverse-trace decreases strictly under any feasible unequalizing transfer. Finite transfers terminate at exactly the claimed canonical profiles and establish necessity, sufficiency and uniqueness up to permutations. Eight hundred twenty-eight exact full-matrix inversions, sixty-six exhaustive budget tests and 5,082 derivative tests reproduce the algebra at small parameters; these checks are not substituted for the all-size proof.

value.rationale: A natural infinite family of multi-community networks receives an exact global leader-placement classification for every budget, rather than an approximate selection or an ad hoc isolated instance. The result determines every optimum allocation up to symmetry, reduces selection to constructing one set, and supplies a strict majorization comparison useful for reasoning about clustering vs distributing leaders; a nontrivial r=3 instance separates the optimum (10/9) from equal allocation (5/4). It is not an arbitrary finite slice, a known-table recomputation or a numerical-only observation.
